steps: An unsaved edit blocks opening script creation; restoring the exact editor contents restores the entry without writing author files.

The action retry starter option shows exact ordinary GDScript source in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px. Mode, path, focus, source and reachable Create/Cancel controls persist; cancelling writes nothing.
Create opens an ordinary unsaved TXT draft; Save adds exactly its source and registration while preserving all existing author files.

Manage existing behavior explicitly registers one script reference. The ordinary behavior editor adds one instance binding and all explicit String parameters, retains every existing binding, and preserves focus/review in three languages. Cancel discards the first binding review. Apply changes only a draft; Save changes only the behavior JSON.
Reopening the saved behavior restores the same instance UUID, script identity and all parameter values. An unchanged review grants no Apply ticket and closing writes nothing.
Reopening restores the instance UUID and all literal String parameters. Unchanged review cannot apply. No other author script, scene, HUD or input-map declaration changes.
dialogs: 今回のスクリプト作成設定を破棄しますか？エディターの内容は変更されません。
丢弃本次脚本选择与审阅？已保存的引用会保留。
丢弃本次行为表单修改？原文草稿不会改变。

script-zh-CN.label: Godot / 按动作重试关卡
script-zh-CN.description: 等待 action_name 的新按下，重新进入 target_scene_id 指定的其他组装成员；state_values_json 为显式初始值 JSON 对象，最多16个标量键、4096 UTF-8字节。只复位列出的键，保留其他进度；请求受理后在切换前一次应用，拒绝不改状态。需释放重按，不支持原地重启。

script-en.label: Godot / Retry level on action
script-en.description: Waits for a new press of action_name, then re-enters another assembly member named by target_scene_id. state_values_json is an explicit JSON object with at most 16 scalar keys and 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Resets only the listed keys and preserves other progress. Accepted defaults apply together before switching; refusal changes no state. Release and press again to retry. Does not restart the current scene.

script-ja.label: Godot / アクションでレベルを再試行
script-ja.description: action_name の新しい押下で、target_scene_id が示す別の組み立てメンバーへ再入場します。state_values_json は初期値の JSON オブジェクトで、スカラー値のキー16個、UTF-8で4096バイトまでです。指定したキーのみ初期化し、他の進捗は保持します。受理後に切り替え前の値を一括適用し、拒否時は変更しません。再試行には離してから押し直してください。同じシーンの直接再起動には対応しません。

limitations: Real Chrome with HTTP editor and disposable author files. This smoke verifies authoring only; it does not execute the retry script or simulate actual input.

No installed Tauri, Android, Bevy, native game execution, or generated project delivery is claimed. The three-scene project, HUDs and saved input map are pre-populated fixture data; authoring and saving the added scripts and behavior parameters are the tested scope.
